bactromod.options.title: BactroMod Settings
bactromod.options.itemScalingFactors.des: Adjusts the size of individual items held in first person so they cover less of the screen.
bactromod.options.gammaMultiplier.desc: Controls additional world brightness. 1 uses vanilla lighting; 15 provides maximum brightness.
bactromod.options.pumpkinBlur.desc: Shows or hides the view-obscuring overlay displayed when wearing a carved pumpkin.
bactromod.options.fireOffset.desc: Adjusts the height of the first-person fire overlay. Negative values move it down.
bactromod.options.shieldOffset.desc: Adjusts the height of the shield in first person. Negative values move it down.
bactromod.options.showMapWhileInBoat.des: Keeps maps visible while moving in a boat.
bactromod.options.lavaFog.desc: Shows or hides fog while submerged in lava.
bactromod.options.powderSnowFog.desc: Shows or hides fog while inside powder snow.
bactromod.options.blindnessFog.desc: Shows or hides fog caused by the Blindness effect.
bactromod.options.darknessFog.desc: Shows or hides fog caused by the Darkness effect.
bactromod.options.waterFog.desc: Shows or hides fog while submerged in water.
bactromod.options.atmosphericFog.desc: Shows or hides atmospheric distance fog.
bactromod.options.fixShieldRiptideTriden: Fixes the position of a shield in the Off Hand while spinning with a Riptide trident.
bactromod.options.ignoreOpGamemodeSwitch: Allows opening and using the F3+F4 game mode switcher without permission.
bactromod.options.nightVision.desc: Controls whether the brightness boost from the Night Vision effect is rendered.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.bactromod: A lightweight client-side mod with useful visual and gameplay tweaks.
